visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female singer with short curly hair, wearing a black and white striped dress, performs on a dark stage illuminated by multiple diagonal yellow spotlights. In the background, band members play a keyboard and electric guitar under dimmed lights. (2) The background screen shifts to display a serene landscape graphic with silhouettes of trees reflected in water against a golden sky. The singer continues her performance with expressive hand gestures and focused facial expressions. (3) The scene cuts to a closer interaction where the singer is at the edge of the stage, singing directly to fans in the front row who are recording with smartphones. (4) The stage lighting transitions to purple and blue hues as the camera captures a wide shot of the singer and the drummer behind her. (5) A series of close-up shots show the singer's face as she sings with high emotional intensity, her eyes closed or gazing upward. (6) The video concludes with a grand finale where red and white confetti bursts from the ceiling, filling the frame as the singer bows and the audience cheers from the darkened seating area.
